targets.artifactContract: Pin the exact independently accepted build artifact and its digest before release.
targets.distributionContract: Use the owner's selected web runtime and release route; no deployment is authorized by this template.
targets.postDeployAcceptance: Exercise all accepted product journeys against the deployed revision, including persistence, failure and recovery scenarios.
targets.rollbackPlan: Retain the preceding artifact and data recovery plan; use only the owner's separately granted recovery authority.
